sentences: Psychedelic caution: Don't take UMP on psychedelic days.

If it makes your dreams vivid or suddenly lowers your psychedelic tolerance, take that as a safety signal, and if you do use psychedelics later, assume your previous dose may now be too strong, since chasing the old visual threshold can overshoot.
